name: Pipeliners - Not-Indexed Improvements 2026-09-29
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
Round 2 of not-indexed improvements, live Sep 28 16:39 UTC server time (Kim's Sep 29). Of "the 6 non-hold pages" only 2 qualified: two others had small ad impressions, one was already rewritten and one was held for Scott.

# Key findings
- 13724 /are-your-pipes-due-for-a-checkup/ (plumbing inspection): 4,383 to 1,600 words; filler replaced with question H2s, a what-it-checks table, a repair, restore or replace decision table, a section on when replacement wins, and a 4-question FAQ.
- 13710 /2024-homeowners-plumbing-guide/ (plumbing maintenance): 3,680 to 1,455 words; monthly routine, pipe-material table, DIY vs pro, emergency prep, FAQ. Unsplash credit links removed; the unverified "only licensed ePipe partner" claim removed.
- Claims used: 50-year liner life, UV LED cure, NSF/ANSI 61, 24/7, leak-locating equipment. No prices or warranty terms.

# Decisions and status
- Inbound links added from four ad-free indexed posts. Undo via post meta `_pl_backup_ni_20260929`.
- Request Indexing Sep 29: URL Inspection showed both were already indexed (the Page indexing report was stale, last updated Sep 21).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `CHANGES.md`, before/after HTML and headers, PHP and Python scripts.
